The candidates disagreed. Allen Jones supported empowering future mayors with fewer boards and commissions; Bilal Mahmood argued that reducing redundant commissions could make government more accountable and efficient. Autumn Looijen did not submit a response. Dean Preston said the mayor already has substantial power and that commissioners should be more independent and less beholden to the mayor.
